inspection.scope: Sections2.1-2.3 complete displayed Lagrangians, pre-breaking gauge model and real scalar mediator variant.
inspection.coverage_note: These are passages and model-definition sections actually inspected, not a claim that every sentence on each page or the entire PDF was read. Field claims are retained separately in field-evidence.json; legacy records remain unchecked reference material.

claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

Dirac SM-singlet psi and complex SM-singlet phi share Dmu=partial+i eprime V, hence unit hidden charge in the same explicit source coordinate. SM fields hidden neutral; phi Higgses U1prime. V is its gauge connection, not additional matter. Dirac psi expands into two LH conjugate rows.
Scalar portal adds a singlet fermion psi with ordinary Dirac kinetic/mass bilinear and a real scalar phi: half kinetic and phi^2 mass distinguish one real field. No extra gauge factor.

Neutrino portal adds one real S, one independent Majorana Nprime and RH-neutrino mediator species; displayed generation indices/copy count of NR not fixed. Alternative complexification is a distinct source option, not automatic doubling of the baseline.
